name: JL_BR_SPED_ACCT_CONFIGS_F
description: This table contains the accounting configuration setup for legal entity and legal reporting unit.

columns.name: SPED_ACCT_CONF_ID
columns.description: SPED accounting configuration identifier.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity identifier representing the first party.

columns.name: REPORTING_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Level code at which SPED reporting is done, that is Centralized or Decentralized.

columns.name: LEGAL_REPORTING_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Legal reporting unit identifier representing the first party.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier used to identify the accounting flexfield segment type for defining participants.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: BOOKKEEPING_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The type of bookkeeping to be maintained. Valid values are: a complete daily book without auxiliary bookkeeping, daily book with auxiliary and summarized bookkeeping, and daily book and balances with auxiliary and summarized bookkeeping.

columns.name: BOOK_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of the book that is maintained.

columns.name: BOOK_NAME
columns.description: Name of the book that is maintained.

columns.name: AUX_BOOKKEEPING_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of auxiliary bookkeeping used for other summarized bookkeeping types. Valid value is an auxiliary daily book with summarized bookkeeping.

columns.name: AUXILIARY_BOOK_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of auxiliary bookkeeping.

columns.name: AUXILIARY_BOOK_NAME
columns.description: Name of the auxiliary book that is maintained.

columns.name: AUXILIARY_BOOK_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of the auxiliary book that is maintained.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_STMT_IDENT_CODE
columns.description: Identification code of the accounting statement type.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_STMT_HDR_TEXT
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: REF_COA_ID
columns.description: Identification code of the referential chart of accounts.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_STMT_FREQ_CODE
columns.description: Frequency of the accounting statements.

columns.name: REVERT_NEG_JOURNALS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether negative journal amounts should be converted to positive amounts. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether SPED accounting configuration is active. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
